visualCharacteristics.purpose: Image cards (image, title, description) where the entire card is a single link

contentPattern.description: 2 image cards: Economic Indicators Dashboard, Asset Class Dashboard - each image + title + description, whole card linked
contentPattern.structure: one row per card; cell 1: image; cell 2: title (heading or bold paragraph), description, link. The first link becomes the card link.

usage: Dashboards, tools or resource tiles where the whole tile navigates to one destination.
reuseGuidance: Author exactly one link per card (its URL is used for the whole card). Use cards-links for text-only link cards.
